tasks.title: Per-user trust calibration metric: ratio of accepts/rejects/investigates by confidence tier; personal-only dashboard
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.1. Synthesis Q1 #6. Personal metric, **never shared with managers** (the synthesis is explicit on this). Reads `local_acceptance_rate` from ADR-0023 §1 local_user_state schema.

tasks.title: Per-user budget tuning that learns from post-hoc accuracy (±50% from initial 25-item / 45-min baseline)
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.2. Synthesis Q2 #7. Adaptive layer over Phase 5's static threshold (p5-r13). **human_checkpoint** because adaptive personalization has known drift failure modes. Define 'post-hoc accuracy' precisely before implementing — synthesis suggests agreement with verifier outcomes.

tasks.title: Insert one novel-type item per five Tier-2 items to support knowledge-transfer benefit (Bacchelli & Bird)
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.3. Synthesis Q2 #8. Smart-Catch-up insertion in Tier 2 sort. Inserts a novel-type item (a category the user hasn't reviewed in N days) every fifth Tier-2 position.

tasks.title: Buddy/mentor pairing affordance: node-comment that pings a designated mentor without escalating to general team channels
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.4. Synthesis Q3 #8. Depends on V1.1.5 (per-node comment threads). Mentor designation is per-user setting; the node-comment with mentor mention generates an inbox item.

tasks.title: Per-node comment threads with @-mentions generating inbox items
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.5. Synthesis Q4 #6. **human_checkpoint** because the schema for comment threads is a substrate addition. Lives in graph (not separate channel) per Linear/Notion pattern. Depends on Phase 5's branch-and-review substrate landing first (ADR-0023).

tasks.title: Permission model mapped to GitHub roles (read/write/admin)
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.6. Synthesis Q4 #7. **human_checkpoint** for security review. Read = canvas/inbox view; write = edit nodes on own branch; admin = approve merges, resolve conflicts. Maps to existing GitHub roles for adoption ease.

tasks.title: Hourly batching for low-priority drift events on stable nodes
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.9. Synthesis adjacent finding (notification design): 'batching by type within time-window reduces notification fatigue 40-80%.' Tuning of Phase 4 inbox; non-blocking for L2.

tasks.title: Quiet hours setting (default off, opt-in)
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.10. Now 'table stakes' per synthesis adjacent finding. Per-user setting in local_user_state.

tasks.title: Auto-filter previously-dismissed items of same exact type (Sentry-style)
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.11. Synthesis adjacent finding: 'default-filter-out low-priority is critical at scale.' Reads `local_inbox_state.status='dismissed'`.

tasks.title: Verify direct manipulation is preserved as a first-class operation alongside proposal review (no implementation; documentation + audit)
tasks.notes: Coverage matrix V1.1.12. **'Verify, do not implement.'** Synthesis adjacent finding: ensure the user can edit any node directly without going through a proposal flow. The TipTap editor (tech-spec §3.5) and the assert-this affordance (p4-r18) jointly satisfy this; this task is a v1.1 audit to confirm no Phase 4–5 work has accidentally constrained direct edit paths.

tasks.title: Adopt Linear-style snooze with conditional resurface as the default snooze pattern
tasks.notes: If Phase 4's bulk-snooze (p4-r09) shipped a simpler time-based snooze rather than activity-based, this task adds the conditional resurface ('come back when there's new information'). Synthesis adjacent finding: conditional resurface is preferred to time-based snooze.

tasks.title: [v1.2+] Opt-in 'unaided review' mode where AI's stated reasoning is hidden during review
tasks.notes: **v1.2+ per synthesis line 609** — explicitly tagged as not-v1.1. Coverage matrix V1.1.7. Synthesis adjacent finding (skill atrophy): forced unaided practice on regular cadence. Frame as skill-retention practice, not productivity feature.

tasks.title: [v1.2+] Per-user agreement rate between unaided judgments and verifier outcomes (personal calibration metric)
tasks.notes: **v1.2+ per synthesis line 609.** Coverage matrix V1.1.8. Pairs with V1.2 R01.
